difficulty_reason: The auxiliary uniform permutation of states is independent of the walk; conditioning on the visited set and a fixed trajectory gives the exact 1/k probability that the new checking label is the last discovered state. Coupling this with strong Markov control of the conditional added waiting time yields the harmonic sum for every irreducible finite chain. The non-routine randomization is constructed and used in the collected proof, not supplied as an assumed bound.
